milestone.title: Sidebar polish + log pane box + Catppuccin Mocha theme

intent.outcome: The TUI looks unmistakably modern: the active sidebar panel pops via accent border + Surface0 title bg + Mauve title, the log pane is a collapsible bordered box (Accent border while a command runs), and DarkTheme is Catppuccin Mocha (LightTheme hex values unchanged).

problem.description: The sidebar marks the active panel only with Accent vs Subtle border color — easy to miss. The command log is plain SubtleText with no box, title, or collapse. DarkTheme is generic purple-on-dark (#7C3AED / #1F2937), not a distinctive palette.

in_scope: DarkTheme() in internal/gui/style/theme.go → Catppuccin Mocha: Accent=#cba6f7 Mauve, Secondary=#94e2d5 Teal, Success=#a6e3a1 Green, Warning=#f9e2af Yellow, Error=#f38ba8 Red, Subtle=#6c7086 Overlay0, Text=#cdd6f4 Text, Bg=#1e1e2e Base.
LightTheme() hex values stay exactly as today: Accent=#34548a Secondary=#0891b2 Success=#33635c Warning=#8f5e15 Error=#8c4351 Subtle=#9699a3 Text=#343b58 Bg=#f5f5f5.

New styles in ApplyTheme: ActivePanelBg (Dark Surface0 #313244 bg; Light Surface0 #ccd0da bg), PanelTitleActive (AccentColor+Bold), LogBorder (RoundedBorder + SubtleColor fg). Active sidebar box keeps Accent BorderForeground via existing renderBox; do not switch border shape (stay rounded).

renderSidebar() in internal/gui/render.go: active panel title line uses ActivePanelBg + PanelTitleActive; inactive titles stay PanelTitle. No arrow glyph. renderBox active=true still uses Accent border color.

renderMainPanel() wraps commandLog in a Lip Gloss box titled 'Log' using LogBorder; when a task/op is running (m.tasks busy or m.opState != nil), border foreground is AccentColor instead of SubtleColor.
Model.logCollapsed bool default false. Case "C" (Shift+C) in internal/gui/gui.go Update key switch toggles it. When true, cmdLogHeight=0 and main content takes the freed rows.
globalHints in renderBottomBar() (internal/gui/render.go) adds {"C", "log"} or equivalent collapse-log hint. Not help.go.
Unit tests: active title styling path; log box title present; Update with tea.KeyMsg "C" toggles logCollapsed; collapsed height path; running vs idle log border color branch.
out_of_scope: Catppuccin Latte full light-theme redesign (LightTheme palette stays pre-M14 hex).
M16 List tab / underline tab restyle / formulae table.
Per-panel loading state indicators beyond existing spinner in title.
Golden-file snapshot regeneration (presentation snapshots are content-based).

design_decisions.choice: Keep Accent rounded border + add Surface0 title bg + Mauve bold title; no arrow; no thick border
design_decisions.rationale: Border color already works as a weak signal; layering bg+title color makes active unmistakable without changing border geometry (rounded stays). Thick borders would clash with inactive rounded boxes.

design_decisions.choice: Shift+C (tea key "C") toggles logCollapsed; hint shown as C in bottom bar
design_decisions.rationale: Lowercase c is taken by panel actions (Status/Services cleanup). Capital C is free in the global Update switch. Bottom bar lives in renderBottomBar, not help.go.

design_decisions.choice: Log box border Subtle when idle, Accent while any task/op is running
design_decisions.rationale: Gives a glanceable work-in-progress cue tied to the stream the user is watching, without a second status widget.

steps.action: Replace DarkTheme() colors in internal/gui/style/theme.go with Catppuccin Mocha (Accent=#cba6f7, Secondary=#94e2d5, Success=#a6e3a1, Warning=#f9e2af, Error=#f38ba8, Subtle=#6c7086, Text=#cdd6f4, Bg=#1e1e2e). Leave LightTheme() hex values unchanged (document baseline in test).

steps.action: Add Model.logCollapsed bool (default false). In gui.go Update key switch, case "C": toggle m.logCollapsed. Add {"C","log"} to globalHints in renderBottomBar() (render.go). Do not edit help.go for this hint.

steps.action: In ApplyTheme, define ActivePanelBg (bg Surface0: dark #313244, light #ccd0da), PanelTitleActive (AccentColor+Bold), LogBorder (RoundedBorder + SubtleColor). Export as package-level styles like existing ones.

steps.action: Update renderSidebar() so the active panel title line uses ActivePanelBg + PanelTitleActive; inactive titles use PanelTitle. Keep renderBox(..., active) Accent/Subtle border behavior unchanged (rounded). No arrow glyph.

steps.action: In renderMainPanel(), wrap commandLog in a Lip Gloss rounded box titled "Log". Idle border = LogBorder/SubtleColor. findings.description: View→logBusy→tasks.IsRunning raced with rt.done write outside mutex during teatest. Fixed: set rt.done under Manager.mu in readChunk.
Log box border/title initially overflowed cmdLogHeight budget, clipping sidebar titles in teatest FinalOutput. Fixed: content width/height account for border overhead.

TestLogCollapsedFreesMainHeight only checks command text is hidden when collapsed; the Height comparison is empty and does not lock AC-05 (cmdLogHeight=0 and mainContentHeight absorbs rows). Assert height math: with known width/height, expanded cmdLogHeight=total/5 (>=2) and mainContentHeight=total-cmdLog; collapsed cmdLogHeight=0 and mainContentHeight=total. Optionally export or duplicate the formula in the test.
findings.author: coordinator
findings.summary: AC-05 height gain not asserted; TestLogCollapsedFreesMainHeight is a no-op
